name: Use B for bookmarks, in the je sandbox once the switch-off checklist is complete (Jellyfin Enhanced's Bookmark Current Time 'Disabled' on 12.11, another key such as 'Shift+X' on 12.12, whose Keyboard tab takes no text): as admin, Bookmarks' settings page, Data tab, 'Use B for bookmarks' offered and clicked: the server's bookmark shortcut becomes B and the Settings tab's field shows it; after a reload the player's tooltip names B, B makes a bookmark of ours (no JE modal) and Shift+B no longer does. The bookmark it makes is deleted; bookmarks-je-web-probe.mjs puts the shortcut back.

steps.name: the server: the checklist complete, Use B offered
steps.eval: (e => ({ complete: e.Overlap.Complete, canUseB: e.Overlap.CanUseB, note: e.Overlap.UseBNote, jeKey: e.Shortcuts.BookmarkCurrentTime }))((await ApiClient.getJSON(ApiClient.getUrl('Bookmarks/Admin/Diagnostics'))).JellyfinEnhanced)

steps.name: the page and its Diagnostics loaded
Use B for bookmarks shown and enabled
the server's shortcut is B, and the field says so
the button goes once B is ours
reload, so the page reads the capabilities again
find Long Test Movie
steps.eval: (await ApiClient.getItems(ApiClient.getCurrentUserId(), { IncludeItemTypes: 'Movie', Recursive: true, SearchTerm: 'Long Test Movie', Limit: 1 })).Items[0].Id

steps.name: details page with a Play button
one bookmark of ours, with its toast
Shift+B is no longer the shortcut: still one bookmark more
delete the bookmark this check made
steps.script: const list = await ApiClient.getJSON(ApiClient.getUrl('Bookmarks', { itemId: __vars.movieId })); const mine = list.filter(b => !b.Name && !b.Note).sort((a, b) => Date.parse(b.CreatedAt) - Date.parse(a.CreatedAt)).slice(0, list.length - Number(__vars.before)); for (const b of mine) { await ApiClient.ajax({ type: 'DELETE', url: ApiClient.getUrl('Bookmarks/' + b.Id) }); } return mine.length;
